description: Find Steam curators by name. Use it when someone names a curator (for example one that emailed them asking for a key) and you need its Curator Match id. Matching ignores case, spacing and punctuation, and a part of the name is enough. A Steam curator link or id also works. Returns up to ten curators, biggest first, with followers, warning level and links.

name.description: The curator's name or part of it, such as "PC Gamer" or "shotgun". A Steam curator link or id also works.

name: search_curators
title: Search curators by name
